govt_response.title: CM Dhami: UCC fulfils the 2022 election promise (DD News)
govt_response.summary: Dhami says the BJP has fulfilled its 2022 assembly-election promise and that Uttarakhand is the first state to bring a UCC into force.

analysis:
Campaigning for the 2022 Uttarakhand assembly election, Dhami promised on 12 February 2022 that a re-elected BJP government would set up a committee to draft a Uniform Civil Code and implement it.

The state cabinet approved the formation of a drafting committee headed by a former Supreme Court judge in its first meeting after the election (March 2022). The UCC Bill was passed by the Assembly in February 2024 and received presidential assent on 11 March 2024.

Uttarakhand notified and implemented the UCC on 27 January 2025, becoming the first state in independent India to bring such a code into force.
notes: The promise carried a target (implement a UCC) but no fixed calendar date; deadline is therefore null. Dhami later stated the commitment was made on 12 February 2022.
